description:
Repair Med Gas Systems

The Department of Veterans Affairs, Salem, Virginia has a requirement for a Contractor to provide all labor, material, equipment, and qualified supervision necessary to perform work as described in the drawings and specifications for Project #658-26-121 Repair Med Gas Systems provided in forthcoming Solicitation.  

Magnitude of construction is between $250,000 and $500,000.

NAICS CODE: 238220 Plumbing, Heating, and Air Conditioning Contractors
Standard Size: $19M

This solicitation is anticipated to be a Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business
(SDVOSB) Set-Aside.  Solicitation material will be available on/about May 06, 2026.  Any
Specifications, Drawings, and Amendments will be posted on this website.  Proposals will be due approximately 30 days after the issuance of the Solicitation.  Location and points of contact for a site visit will be identified in the Solicitation.

This notice is for informational purposes only and is not a request for Proposals.  The
The Government is not obligated to issue a Solicitation as a result of this notice.  No other
information is available until the issuance of the Solicitation.  No Proposal list is maintained.  All
interested vendors should register on this website.  It is the offeror s responsibility to check the
website periodically for any Amendments/Notices to the Solicitation.  Prospective contractors
must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) database in order to obtain
access to Contract Opportunities under sam.gov SAM and must be current and active to be
eligible for contract awards.

Any questions regarding this announcement and all future announcements regarding this
project must be emailed to Taneil.Crump@va.gov. 

NO TELEPHONE REQUEST FOR BIDDING MATERIAL WILL BE ACCEPTED
